product_summary: Bee Chems (E-5, Panki Industrial Area, Site-1, Kanpur, UP; est. 1972, founder/CEO Somendra Bhalla) — specialty chemical manufacturer, self-described 'first Indian company to manufacture colloidal silica'. Real product lines per own site (beechems.com/products, /product/molecular-sieves/, /about-us/): (1) Nano sols & silicates — colloidal silica sol, sodium silicate, potassium silicate, lithium silicate, Cemsyn/Cemgel nano silica; (2) Adsorbents/desiccants — MolCat molecular sieves 3A/4A/5A/13X beads & pellets, Actas/Actal activated alumina, Sorbogel silica gel (blue/orange), clay desiccant, calcium chloride desiccant, desiccant sachets/bags (Dew Pouch), container/cargo desiccant, humidity indicator cards & plugs; (3) CO2 absorbents — CoxOut soda lime, medical & diving grade soda lime; (4) Lithium salts — lithium acetate, lithium bromide (and solution), lithium chloride, lithium hydroxide anhydrous, lithium fluoride, lithium nitrate; (5) Shelf-life extension — Freppe 1-MCP ethylene inhibitor, ethylene absorbers/scrubbers, oxygen absorbers; (6) Construction chemicals — Acimor acid-resistant mortars, densifiers/sealers/guards, calcium silicate. Also carbon molecular sieve (CMS) for PSA nitrogen.
comment: Declared HS 381590 ('reaction initiators, accelerators and catalytic preparations, n.e.s.') is only partially corroborated. The site's own product list contains no catalyst or polymerisation-accelerator line; the closest genuine 3815-family item is the CO2 absorbent / soda lime (CoxOut, medical & diving grade), which is a chemical preparation n.e.s. and is more precisely 3824.99 (or 3815.90 only if sold as a catalytic/absorbent preparation). Molecular sieves (MolCat zeolites 3A/4A/5A/13X) are correctly 3824.99, not 3815.90; carbon molecular sieve also 3824.99. Other lines map to: colloidal silica sol 3824.99 (or 2811.22 for silica in other forms), silica gel 3824.99/2811.22, activated alumina 2818.20, calcium chloride desiccant 2827.20, lithium chloride 2827.39, lithium bromide 2827.59, lithium hydroxide 2825.20, lithium acetate 2915.29, lithium nitrate 2834.29, lithium fluoride 2826.19, sodium/potassium silicate 2839.19/2839.90, calcium silicate 2836.50, acid-resistant mortar/refractory cements 3816.00, densifiers/sealers 3824.40, 1-MCP ethylene inhibitor 3824.99 (or 2902.19 for the active), oxygen absorbers 3824.99, humidity indicator cards 3824.99/4821.10, desiccant sachets 3824.99. Industry label 'Нефтегаз и химия' is broadly right (petrochemical/refinery adsorbent applications) but the company is a specialty silica/alumina/lithium chemicals maker, not an oilfield services firm — no upstream oil & gas equipment in the range. No trader signs: own plant, own R&D lab, own registered trademarks (MolCat, Actas, CoxOut, Adox, Sorbogel, Freppe, Acimor, Cemsyn, Dew Pouch) — manufacturer role. Product lines entirely missing from the single declared code: lithium salts (6 products), construction chemicals, ethylene/oxygen absorbers, silicates. Per project rule 3 the HS mismatch is not a rejection ground: company retained, code to be corrected to the actual mix (lead code 3824.99, with 2818.20 / 2827.xx / 2839.xx / 2915.29 as secondary). All product data above is from the company's own website — no customs line was checked in this task, so shipment-level corroboration is 'заявлено, не подтверждено'.
